changes.summary: Pinned Liquid AI's corrected a3af5799 LFM2.5-VL snapshot.
changes.details: The official correction sets min_tiles to 2 and text_config.max_position_embeddings to 32768. The model weights are unchanged, but config.json and processor_config.json changed, so the immutable model version and adapter source bundle are refreshed and existing installs require reinstall.

changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Added the immutable official LFM2.5-VL-3B BF16 checkpoint as a complete one-Spark Pending recipe.
Added offline CUDA 13 ARM64 vLLM serving with local images, multi-image prompting, and parsed LFM2 tool calls.
Declared text, screen, scanned-document, OCR, layout, and normalized-coordinate grounding capabilities.
